$comment: UI font choices (M130). `files` names faces in resources/fonts, fetched by `npm run fetch-binaries` from the Liberation (OFL 1.1) and DejaVu (Bitstream Vera / public-domain additions) families that M10 already bundles and credits — no new download and no new licence. A build without the fetched fonts simply falls back to `stack`, so nothing here can break the interface. `stack` is the CSS list used when the bundled face is unavailable, and is always the last word for characters the face has no glyph for.

fonts.label: System default
fonts.note: Whatever this computer uses for its own menus and dialogs.
fonts.stack: system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

fonts.label: Liberation Sans
fonts.note: A plain sans-serif with wide, open letters. The same on all three systems.

fonts.label: DejaVu Sans
fonts.note: Larger and rounder than Liberation Sans at the same size — often easier to read.

fonts.label: Liberation Serif
fonts.note: A serif face, if you find serifs easier to follow along a line.

fonts.label: DejaVu Sans Mono
fonts.note: Every character the same width. Distinguishes 1, l and I clearly.
